close_reason: Superseded by JMAP-7a8b.1 (same issue, more precise framing)
description: MdnSendResult.sent and .not_sent are pub fields with HashMap<Id, _> keys. Once any downstream crates use this (e.g. backend implementors), changing to HashMap<String, _> is a breaking API change. The fix is now: change Id to String before v0.1. The MdnBackend trait's send_mdns also takes HashMap<Id, Mdn> — same issue. Both need to change together.
title: MdnSendResult public API uses Id for creation IDs — will fossilize before next release
